style: Say in a clear, informative way, like a nature documentary narrator
lines: This camera AI names every animal it sees. Each square shows what an animal really was and what the model said. Tap a square off the diagonal.
That square holds the right answers. Tap a square off the diagonal to see the mistakes.
Each wrong photo shows the training photos it was matched to. Look for the reason, then change something in the toolbox.
You changed the model. Press Run the test.
The rangers sent work orders. Read the complaint, then tap the square where the mistakes are.
Work order one. Where are the foxes?
Goal met. Read what was wrong, then press Next work order.
That fixed one thing and broke another. Check the other rows.
Label changed. Press Run the test to see what it does.
All three work orders are done. Read the last note, then press Start again or open the Garage.
